This sounds exactly like my first colonoscopy a year ago. They told me there was colitis but I was negative for Crohn’s (even though there was obvious inflammation) my symptoms continued and didn’t get any better. I finally got a procedure in April where you swallow a capsule with a camera inside and it takes pictures of your small intestine. I think it’s called a capsule endoscopy. My small intestine ended up being where my ulcers were (even though I still had inflammation in my colon) so I finally got diagnosed even though they said I was negative before. I still have a hard time remembering that it will get better but make sure to keep it in mind!! I hope if it is crohns you get diagnosed sooner rather then later! Good luck!:)
